title: finding(app-shell,plugin-designer): the designer's nav surfaces show a label-less nav entry as blank, "unnamed" or its id — the entries objectui#9868 makes producible inherit their target's label only at runtime
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a seam, class (b). `reach:` named producers.
- `NavigationSyncEffect` writes label-less page and dashboard entries, as of PR objectui#11186 (objectui#9868, ruling A `5731297631`).
- cloud#2021's `apply_blueprint` will write label-less entries once it lands.

`Seam: spec:NavigationItemSchema base label (absent ⇒ inherit the target's CURRENT label at render time) → renderer: the designer / authoring surfaces below`.

Evidence, read at PR objectui#11186's head `26d6862a3` and not rendered in a browser. The dev's raw-reader sweep (report `5908597262`) classified 214 `.label` hits. The instrument is lit: the same sweep on the pre-fix heads catches every reader the PR fixed. It found **0 unfixed runtime readers**. After PR objectui#11186, the sidebar, `nav:menu`, the command palette, search, pins and the mobile tab bar all inherit. It also found **24 SEAM reads** on designer and authoring surfaces that do not inherit:

| surface | file | what a label-less entry shows |
|:--|:--|:--|
| app preview | `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx` (`normalizeNav`) | "unnamed" |
| app nav canvas | `metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx` (`navLabel`) | a positional "Item N" row |
| nav selection / inspector | `metadata-admin/nav-selection.ts`, `inspectors/AppNavInspector.tsx` | `label ?? title ?? name ?? id` |
| Studio nav rail | `studio-design/navSurface.ts` (`resolveSurface`), `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`NavTree`) | `''` or the target name |
| plugin-designer | `plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx`, `AppCreationWizard.tsx` | `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(item.label)` ⇒ empty |

The exact line list is in `5908597262`, `sweep.SEAM`. So a designer previews a nav that differs from what the console draws, for exactly the entries the platform now produces.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11186 (objectui#9868), from `out_of_scope_findings[0]`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each designer surface resolves an absent label the way the runtime does: `resolveNavItemLabel` with the shared `useNavTargetLabel` resolver PR objectui#11186 adds, or a designer-locale twin of it. ⛔ No second inheritance rule.
- An inspector's label field should show the inherited text as a placeholder, not as a stored value. Typing writes an author label, and clearing restores inheritance.
- **Pins:** each surface shows a label-less entry's inherited text; an explicit label renders verbatim (the control).
- **Serial.** `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is held by objectui#11181 and objectui#11189 (in flight). Its rows ride after them.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs plus 300 newer were grepped: `normalizeNav`, `AppNavCanvas` with `label`, `unnamed`, `label-less`. Hits are PR objectui#11186 itself and the closed locale-map family (objectui#11100, #11128, #11148 and their PRs), which is a different defect: a map label, not an absent one. No card covers absent-label inheritance on the designer surfaces.
